run.change_description:
refactor: resolve SonarQube findings

- Reduce cognitive complexity in runProviderBackups, displayStartupConfig,
  checkProvider, Run and checkProvidersDefined by extracting focused
  helpers; behaviour and log output unchanged.
- Extract duplicated backup status titles into constants with a shared
  backupStatusTitle helper (notify.go).
- Remove TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup2 (identical duplicate of
  TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup) and simplify
  TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup with assertion helpers.
- Dockerfile: merge consecutive RUN instructions, sort apk packages,
  quote the TAG variable in the download URL.

summary.intent: Decompose six SonarQube-flagged high-complexity functions into focused helpers, centralize duplicated backup-status-title literals behind one constant/helper, delete an exact-duplicate test, and tidy the Dockerfile (merge RUN layers, sort apk packages, quote ${TAG}), while preserving existing behaviour and log output.
summary.issue_fit: No originating issue; intent drawn from the caller-supplied PR body (jonhadfield/soba#195, spec-pr195) and the single commit's message, which match this diff. All four claimed outcomes are met. The supporting go build/vet/test claim is reproduced; golangci-lint's "0 issues" claim is not independently verifiable offline, but nothing material depends on it given clean build/vet/test.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff (c77f548..136a4850d) read across all 4 changed files (docker/Dockerfile, internal/backup.go, internal/backup_test.go, internal/notify.go). `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test ./internal/ -count=1` (full package suite, 5.257s) ran once at head 136a4850d: all pass; the two GitLab/Gitea live-backup tests skip for missing credentials, as expected offline. One concurrency safety premise about signal-driven-shutdown ordering across the Run()->scheduleBackups()->runScheduledJob() decomposition was verified via a fresh-context worker: holds.

observations.fact: The pre-existing "Organistations" typo in startup-config logging (already present for GitHub, Gitea, and Azure DevOps at the merge-base) is preserved verbatim by the new shared logProviderOrgs helper rather than fixed.
observations.evidence: internal/backup.go:183-186 (`logProviderOrgs`); identical wording existed per-provider at c77f548:internal/backup.go (e.g. "GitHub Organistations: %s", "Gitea Organistations: %s").

observations.fact: TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup calls resetBackups() once inside each switch case and once more unconditionally after the switch on every loop iteration; this pre-existing double reset is preserved unchanged by the refactor.
observations.evidence: internal/backup_test.go:627-635 (head); the same double-call pattern exists at c77f548:internal/backup_test.go:670-707 (merge-base).

observations.fact: The Dockerfile's `rm -f "/var/cache/apk/*"` quotes the glob, which (pre-existing, unchanged by this diff) prevents shell expansion and leaves apk's cache directory contents on the image.
observations.evidence: docker/Dockerfile:8, unchanged text now folded into the merged RUN instruction.
